# Loading
```{r setup}
library(TCGAbiolinks)
library(SummarizedExperiment)
library(dplyr)
library(survival)
library(survminer)
library(ggplot2)
library(pROC)
library(tidyr)

load("SKCM.rda")
```


# Data preparing
```{r}
clinical <- colData(query2) %>% 
  as.data.frame() %>%
  dplyr::select(bcr_patient_barcode, gender, vital_status, days_to_death, age_at_diagnosis, ajcc_pathologic_stage) %>%
  mutate(
    survival_time = ifelse(!is.na(days_to_death), days_to_death / 365, age_at_diagnosis / 365),
    event = ifelse(vital_status == "Dead", 1, 0),
    age_diagnosis = age_at_diagnosis / 365,
    ajcc_pathologic_stage =
      ifelse(is.na(ajcc_pathologic_stage), "Unknown",
             ajcc_pathologic_stage)
  ) %>%
  # Remove patients without valid survival time
  filter(!is.na(survival_time) & survival_time > 0)

log_expr <- log2(assay(query2, "fpkm_uq_unstrand") + 1)

matched_samples <- intersect(rownames(clinical), colnames(log_expr))
clinical <- clinical[matched_samples, ]
log_expr <- log_expr[, matched_samples]
```


# Feature selection
```{r}
# Select top 1000 most variable genes
select_top_var_genes <- function(expr, n = 1000) {
  top_genes <- names(sort(apply(expr, 1, var), decreasing = TRUE))[1:n]
  return(top_genes)
}

# Select top 50 genes associated with survival using Cox p-values
select_surv_genes <- function(expr, time, event, n = 50) {
  pvals <- sapply(1:nrow(expr), function(i) {
    fit <- tryCatch(coxph(Surv(time, event) ~ expr[i,]), error = function(e) NULL)
    if (!is.null(fit)) summary(fit)$coefficients[1, 5] else 1
  })
  names(pvals) <- rownames(expr)
  top_genes <- names(sort(pvals))[1:n]
  return(top_genes)
}

top1k <- select_top_var_genes(log_expr, 1000)
sub_expr <- log_expr[top1k, ]

surv50 <- select_surv_genes(sub_expr,
                            clinical$survival_time,
                            clinical$event, n=50)

expr_final <- t(log_expr[surv50, ])

surv_data <- clinical %>%
  select(survival_time, event,
         age_diagnosis, gender, ajcc_pathologic_stage) %>%
  bind_cols(as.data.frame(expr_final)) %>%
  mutate(
    gender = factor(gender),
    ajcc_pathologic_stage = factor(ajcc_pathologic_stage)
  )
```


# Train/Test Split
```{r}
set.seed(42)
idx_evt    <- which(surv_data$event == 1)
idx_cens   <- which(surv_data$event == 0)
train_idx  <- c(
  sample(idx_evt,  round(0.7 * length(idx_evt))),
  sample(idx_cens, round(0.7 * length(idx_cens)))
)
test_idx   <- setdiff(seq_len(nrow(surv_data)), train_idx)

train_data <- surv_data[train_idx, ]
test_data  <- surv_data[test_idx, ]
```


# Cox model
```{r}
calculate_cindex <- function(pred, time, status) {
  concordance(Surv(time, status) ~ pred)$concordance
}


build_cox_model <- function(train_data, test_data) {
  predictors <- setdiff(names(train_data),
                        c("survival_time","event"))
  form <- as.formula(
    paste("Surv(survival_time, event) ~",
          paste(predictors, collapse = " + "))
  )
  
  cox_model <- coxph(form, data = train_data)
  
  # risk score
  lp <- predict(cox_model, newdata = test_data, type = "lp")
  test_data$risk_score <- as.numeric(lp)
  
  # 1-year mortality indicator
  test_data <- test_data %>%
    mutate(
      surv_1yr = ifelse(survival_time <= 1 & event==1, 1, 0),
      valid   = survival_time >= 1 |
                (survival_time < 1 & event==1)
    )
  
  # ROC & AUC
  auc_val <- NA
  if (sum(test_data$valid) > 10) {
    roc_obj <- roc(test_data$surv_1yr[test_data$valid],
                   test_data$risk_score[test_data$valid])
    auc_val <- as.numeric(auc(roc_obj))
  }
  
  list(
    model     = cox_model,
    test_data = test_data,
    cindex    = calculate_cindex(lp,
                                 test_data$survival_time,
                                 test_data$event),
    auc       = auc_val
  )
}

# Run Cox model
cox_res <- build_cox_model(train_data, test_data)
```


# Visualization
```{r}
# Risk score density
ggplot(cox_res$test_data, aes(x=risk_score, fill=factor(event))) +
  geom_density(alpha=0.6) + theme_minimal() +
  labs(title="Risk Score Distribution",
       x="Risk Score", fill="Event")

# ROC curve
if (!is.na(cox_res$auc)) {
  roc_obj <- roc(cox_res$test_data$surv_1yr[cox_res$test_data$valid],
                 cox_res$test_data$risk_score[cox_res$test_data$valid])
  ggroc(roc_obj) +
    geom_abline(linetype="dashed") +
    theme_minimal() +
    labs(title="ROC for 1-Year Mortality",
         subtitle=paste("AUC =", round(cox_res$auc,3)))
} else {
  ggplot() + annotate("text",0.5,0.5,"Not enough samples for ROC") +
    theme_void()
}

# KM curve
cox_res$test_data$risk_group <- factor(
  ifelse(cox_res$test_data$risk_score > 
         median(cox_res$test_data$risk_score, na.rm=TRUE),
         "High","Low"),
  levels = c("Low","High")
)

km_data <- cox_res$test_data %>%
  filter(
    !is.na(survival_time),
    !is.na(event),
    !is.na(risk_group)
  )

km_fit <- survfit(Surv(survival_time, event) ~ risk_group, data = km_data)
ggsurvplot(km_fit, data = km_data, pval = TRUE, risk.table = TRUE, title = "KM Curve by Risk Group")

# Variable importance
coefs <- summary(cox_res$model)$coefficients
varimp <- data.frame(
  var = rownames(coefs),
  importance = abs(coefs[,"coef"])
) %>% arrange(desc(importance))
ggplot(varimp[1:20,], aes(x=reorder(var,importance),
                          y=importance)) +
  geom_col() + coord_flip() + theme_minimal() +
  labs(title="Top 20 Variables by |Coefficient|",
       x="Variable", y="|Coefficient|")
```


# Metrics Table
```{r}
calib_fit <- coxph(
  Surv(survival_time, event) ~ offset(risk_score) + I(risk_score),
  data = cox_res$test_data
)
cal_slope <- coef(calib_fit)["I(risk_score)"]


metrics <- data.frame(
  Metric = c(
    "C-index",
    "AUC (1-Year Mortality)",
    "Calibration Slope"
  ),
  Value = c(
    round(cox_res$cindex, 3),
    round(cox_res$auc,    3),
    round(cal_slope,      3)
  )
)

knitr::kable(metrics, caption = "Cox Model Evaluation Metrics")
```
